title: Biosecurity Act replaces the Quarantine Act
summary: From 16 June 2016 the Biosecurity Act 2015 replaced the Quarantine Act 1908. It modernised border biosecurity powers and lets businesses manage some biosecurity risks themselves under approved arrangements.
direction_rationale: The Productivity Commission described the new Act's main changes, including approved arrangements under which businesses carry out biosecurity activities themselves.

verified.notes: Assent from the Federal Register; commencement on 16 June 2016 from section 2 (a proclaimed day, or 12 months after assent at the latest).

assessment.summary: A modern biosecurity law with approved arrangements lets importers and others manage some risks under approval instead of waiting for government inspection, a modest saving in time and cost.
